AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 116 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7832, #7834, #7835, #7836 and #7842:

- #7832 → #7098: `audit:partial` (removes OpenClaw's headless Claude CLI ACP path; the broader issue's recovery/guard acceptance is documented separately on #7098).
- #7834 → #7325/#7375/#7366/#7356/#7706: `audit:complete` (five claimant/broker defects fixed).
- #7835: `audit:no-issue` (OpenCode Go quota attribution follow-up; retroactive home #10080).
- #7836: `audit:no-issue` (remaining ChainExt test-literal build break; retroactive home #10081).
- #7842 → #5640: `audit:complete` (empty/unset HOME now fails loudly across Atlas/Fleet search).

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issue/comment captures, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7832-7842/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7832-7842.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 116 valid PRs audited from 120 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 130 identifiers remain, next #7847. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
